description: Travaux et autorisation de voirie sur la commune de La Baule is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Baule-Escoublac. Works and parking authorization on the Commune of La Baule. Data from orders. Coverage: La Baule-Escoublac. The portal shows the English title as "Works and road authorisation in the municipality of La Baule" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Baule-Escoublac. Its keywords include travaux, voirie, rue, stationnement, circulation, citoyennete-institution. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
